trust_decision.summary: The in-app redirect URL is trusted to be safe because it was validated once, at workflow-save time, by the control-values zod regex; every delivery path (API inbox DTO, both JS socket transports, and the browser navigate sink) therefore copies cta.url/primaryCta.url into the response and hands it to window.open with no scheme re-check, and that regex ran on the un-interpolated control value ({{payload.primaryActionUrl}}) while the worker interpolates the payload into the stored cta afterwards.

landing_point.why: The summary names the in-app Inbox and 'notification redirect.url', and this is the place the inbox API turns the stored cta.data.url / cta.action.buttons[].url into the DTO redirect field that the browser client later opens; an engineer would grep cta.data?.url and land here (or on its twin in the client).

fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP API mapper (NestJS inbox usecase util)

fix_sites.entry_point: new @novu/shared util sanitizeInAppRedirect / isValidInAppRedirectUrl used by the API mapper
packages/shared barrel export that makes the new util public
workflow step control-values validation on workflow create/update (dashboard in-app step editor)
@novu/js Inbox UI notification / primary / secondary action click handler (navigate)
inbox realtime transport over the fetch-based socket fallback (https://ws.novu.co)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The framework copy is the code-first SDK's own output contract (it validates what a bridge workflow returns, not what the inbox delivers, and it already rejects javascript:/mailto: by requiring http(s):// or a leading slash), so a solver can argue the javascript: XSS is unreachable through it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Root-relative SPA paths must keep going through routerPush (not be dropped as 'not a URL'), and template-variable URLs must keep matching: the keyless default workflow ships redirect.url = '{{payload.primaryActionUrl}}' and the schema regex must keep accepting {{var}} forms, so an over-broad fix that rejects every non-absolute or every templated URL silently disables the CTA of legitimate notifications.

O6_input_shapes: root-relative path starting with a single slash (/dashboard)
root-relative path containing a template variable (/path/{{id}})
URL that is entirely a template variable ({{url}}, {{url}}/path)
protocol-relative URL (//evil.com, ///evil.com) - newly rejected by the published regex
arbitrary or missing redirect target (target dropped, url kept)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Legacy v0 Notification Center widget API, superseded by /v1/inbox, and the current inbox client never calls it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different module (apps/api/src/app/widgets) from the fixed inbox mapper, same API app, untouched by the fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /v1/subscribers/:subscriberId/notifications/feed (API-key auth) returns the same raw feed via the same usecase
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Server-to-server SDK route for customers building their own in-app UI; the customer renders the CTA, so URL validation looks like the customer's responsibility rather than the inbox contract.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different controller (apps/api/src/app/subscribers) reusing the widgets usecase

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /v1/widgets/messages/:messageId/actions/:type returns the raw MessageEntity (with cta urls) after an action update
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Deprecated widget action endpoint whose response shape is the legacy MessageEntity, not the sanitized inbox DTO.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same widgets controller family as the legacy feed route; untouched by the fix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a scheme check inside the already-existing sanitizeRedirect()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The function is literally named sanitize and already normalises url+target for IN_APP control values; a maintainer extending it to reject unsafe schemes is the natural next edit, and preview generation already routes through it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third copy of the redirect validator in another browser bundle
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: packages/js is intentionally not allowed to depend on @novu/shared, which is why this fix ships the helper twice (the 'Keep in sync' comment at fix.diff:133); any further browser package repeats the duplication.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fifth hard-coded copy of the redirect regex in the keyless template JSON schema
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The keyless bootstrap already pastes the schema four times (587, 601, 627, 650), and this copy is the loosest variant (permits //host and braces anywhere), so the next template-creating path copies a stale regex.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a client-side check on the dashboard redirect editor / live in-app preview
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The dashboard is where an author types redirect.url and it renders a live in-app notification preview, so adding the guard there is the cheap-looking fix a maintainer might choose instead of the shared schema.

O9_family: CWE-79 stored cross-site scripting via unvalidated redirect URL scheme reaching a browser client sink (window.open)
